Attachments included: scim_delta_sample_20260624.log, residual-role-snapshot-20260625.csv, saml_assertion_sample.txt, workback_plan_draft.pdf

1) SCIM delta log (scim_delta_sample_20260624.log) — raw push events exported from our SCIM proxy (connector pulls from Okta and normalizes). File contains: timestamp, operation (PATCH/DELETE/POST), external_id, attribute_changes (json fragment), target_role_id. We redacted user email addresses to the pattern user+redacted@redwood.ai per audit redaction policy.

2) Role snapshot CSV — includes internal_user_id, external_id, role_name, assigned_via (SCIM / manual / service_account), and assigned_at timestamp. The snapshot shows ~18 residual memberships flagged for review (marked in the CSV with review_flag column). These are largely service accounts that retained legacy roles after a migration; we've included maintainer notes in the CSV.

3) SAML assertion sample — taken from a routine admin console login on 2026‑06‑23. We removed the NameID and any raw IPs; signature block and attributes (roles, groups, authncontext) are intact. This is representative for control testing.

4) JIT admin exception log note — PRiyom, I pulled the exceptions referenced below into the workback_plan_draft.pdf (approval ticket links and short justification). We keep these tickets for 90 days; the ticket ids are TICKET‑4832, TICKET‑4891, TICKET‑4910. Approvals were recorded in ServiceNow with approver id and reason.

Additional context:
- SCIM source: Okta for workforce users; HR system -> Okta for provisioning. We perform an internal normalization step that maps Okta groups to Redwood roles via the mapping table at the Drive link.
- Filtering rules: we drop Okta metadata attributes prefixed with internal_ during normalization; attributes needed for role mapping (groups, jobTitle, department) are preserved.

Link to full (internal) artifact folder: https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/security/HS-SOC2/SCIM-samples

If Kara wants unredacted evidence under an NDA channel we can arrange a controlled data room; otherwise these redacted artifacts satisfy the evidence request in our experience.
